arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ إِذَا ابْتُلِيَ أَوْ رَأَى مُبْتَلًى بِفَضِيحَةٍ بِذَنْبٍِ
english_title: 34. When he was afflicted or saw someone afflicted with the Disgrace of Sin

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى سِتْرِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ ،
phrases.english: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for Your covering over after Your knowledge
2.and Your pardon after Your awareness!

phrases.arabic: فَكُلُّنَا قَدِ اقْتَرَفَ الْعَائِبَةَ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْهُ ،
phrases.english: 3.Each of us has committed faults, but You hast not made him notorious,
4.done indecencies, but You hast not disgraced him,
5.and covered over evil deeds, but You hast not pointed to him.
6.How many are Your prohibited acts which we have performed,
7.Your commandments of which You hast told us which we have transgressed,
8.the evil deeds which we have earned, the offenses which we have committed!
9.You seest them to the exclusion of all observers;
10.You hast the power to make them public above all the powerful!

phrases.arabic: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لَنَا حِجَاباً دُونَ أَبْصَارِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 11.By giving us safety You hast veiled their eyes
12.and stopped their ears.
13.So make the shameful things You hast covered over
14.and the inward reality You hast concealed our admonisher,

phrases.arabic: وَزَاجِراً عَنْ سُوْءِ الْخُلْقِ وَاقْتِرَافِ الخَطِيئَـةِ،
phrases.english: 15.a restrainer upon bad character traits and committing offenses,

phrases.arabic: وَسَعْياً إلَى التَّوْبَةِ الْمَاحِيَةِ وَالطَّرِيْقِ الْمَحْمُودَةِ،
phrases.english: 16.and a striving toward the repentance that erases [sins] and the praiseworthy path!
17.Bring the time of striving near
18.and visit us not with heedlessness of You!

phrases.arabic: إنَّا إلَيْكَ رَاغِبُونَ ، وَمِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَائِبُونَ.
phrases.english: 19.Surely we are Your beseechers, the repenters of sins.

phrases.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى خِيَرَتِكَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
phrases.english: 20.And bless Your chosen, O God, from Your creation,

phrases.arabic: مُحَمَّد وَعِتْرَتِهِ الصِّفْـوَةِ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِـكَ الطَّاهِرِينَ ،
phrases.english: 21.Muhammad and his descendants, the friends selected from among Your creatures, the pure,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَامِعِينَ وَمُطِيعِينَ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ .
phrases.english: 22.and make us listeners to them and obeyers, as You hast commanded!
